svg.title: Alert ladder
svg.desc: A marker slides across the water level gauge; each zone highlights the OLED text, LED pattern and buzzer tone used.
svg.text: Water level drives everything. Watch the marker slide and see how the tank responds at each stage.
Gas follows the same pattern: WARNING (blink 0.7 s · 900 Hz) and DANGER (blink 0.3 s · 1600 Hz) share the same LED and buzzer logic. Danger from either source wins.
